docs.title: SpaceLinx MES Documentation
docs.description: Welcome to the SpaceLinx MES (Manufacturing Execution System) documentation. This comprehensive system is designed for aerospace manufacturing and advanced production environments.

docs.title: 🧾 Edit Goods Inventory
docs.description: The Edit Goods Inventory page allows you to view and manage details of a specific goods item that already exists in your inventory.

docs.title: 📦 Goods Inventory
docs.description: The Goods Inventory page helps you manage and track all finished goods or stocked items available in your warehouse.

docs.title: 🧾 Create New Goods Inventory
docs.description: The Create Goods Inventory page allows you to add a new goods item to your inventory list.

docs.title: ⚙️ Parts Inventory
docs.description: The Parts Inventory page helps you track and manage the physical stock of each part across multiple locations and bins.

docs.title: 📘 Guide Details
docs.description: The Guide Details page gives a complete view of an individual guide.

docs.title: 📖 Guides Module – User Guide
docs.description: A Guide is a documented instruction, reference, or work procedure that helps teams follow standardized processes in manufacturing, assembly, or maintenance.

docs.title: 📘 Create/Edit Guide
docs.description: The Create/Edit Guide form allows users to add new guides or edit existing ones.

docs.title: Material Kits
docs.description: A Material Kit is a pre-packaged set of parts, tools, or components grouped together for a specific manufacturing task or work order.

docs.title: 📝 How to Create a New Material Kit
docs.description: The New Material Kit feature allows you to quickly create a kit by linking it to a part and location, specifying quantity, and optionally attaching an image.

docs.title: Create New Product
docs.description: The New Product page allows users to create a new product by linking it to an existing released part, associating it with a platform, adding a description, and optionally uploading an image.

docs.title: 📦 Products Module – Overview
docs.description: The Products module in SpaceLinx MES is designed to act as the core hub for manufacturing execution.

docs.title: 📘 Create work order
docs.description: The Create work order flyout allows users to create a new manufacturing/work order for a part or product.

docs.title: 📋 Work Order Details
docs.description: Once you select a Work Order from the list, you will be taken to the Work Order Details page.

docs.title: 📑 Work Orders
docs.description: A Work Order (WO) is a formal document that specifies tasks, operations, or production activities to be performed in a manufacturing process.

docs.title: Work Order Steps
docs.description: The Work Order Step page gives you a complete view of a specific Work Order, including its steps, progress, timing, materials, and BOM (Bill of Materials).

docs.title: Engineering Change Order (ECO)
docs.description: An Engineering Change Order (ECO) is a formal document used to propose, review, and approve changes to a part, product design, or process.

docs.title: Create a New ECO
docs.description: The New ECO (Engineering Change Order) screen allows you to record changes to existing parts or assemblies. It ensures every modification is documented with proper reasoning, priority, and impact analysis.

docs.title: Machines Module
docs.description: The Machines module in SpaceLinx MES is built to manage all production equipment and machinery within your manufacturing ecosystem. Machines are critical assets that require structured documentation, tracking, and categorization for seamless operations.

docs.title: 🏭 Create Machine
docs.description: The Create Machine form allows users to add new machines into the system.

docs.title: Bill of Materials (BOM) – Create & Manage
docs.description: The BOM Creation page allows you to attach child parts to a parent part, define their quantities, and manage relationships between parts. This is used to define how a product is built.

docs.title: 📘 Clone BOM – User Guide
docs.description: The Clone BOM (Bill of Materials) feature allows you to duplicate the structure of an existing BOM (all the parts and assemblies it contains) to another part in your system. This is particularly useful when you have multiple similar products or assemblies and want to reuse an existing BOM without manually creating it again.

docs.title: Edit Part Flyout
docs.description: The Edit Part Flyout allows you to view and update details of a selected part in the system.

docs.title: Create a New Part
docs.description: The New Part page allows you to create and register new parts in the system. Each part can include key details such as its type, name, measurement unit, manufacturing number, and an optional image.

docs.title: 📘 Parts Module – User Guide
docs.description: The Parts module helps you manage all the components, materials, and products used in your manufacturing process. From here, you can create, edit, organize, and track each part in your system.

docs.title: 🛠️ Create Tool
docs.description: The Create Tool form allows users to add a new tool into the system.

docs.title: Tools Module
docs.description: The Tools module in SpaceLinx MES is designed to manage all equipment, instruments, and devices that are essential for manufacturing operations. Every tool used in production needs to be properly recorded, categorized, and tracked to ensure accuracy, availability, and compliance.

docs.title: Editing a Goods Receipt Note (GRN)
docs.description: The Goods Receipt Note (GRN) is used to confirm the receipt of materials against a Purchase Order.

docs.title: Goods Receipts – Overview
docs.description: The Goods Receipts (GRN) page allows you to view, create, and manage goods receipt notes that record materials received against purchase orders.

docs.title: Create Goods Receipt Note (New GRN)
docs.description: The New GRN form allows you to create a new Goods Receipt Note (GRN) based on purchase orders.

docs.title: Purchase Order – Line Items
docs.description: The Line Items section is where you define the materials or services being purchased in a Purchase Order (PO). It includes controls for adding new items, applying discounts, setting tax options, selecting a currency, and reviewing the cost summary.

docs.title: Create Purchase Order
docs.description: The Create Purchase Order screen allows you to raise a new purchase order by filling in vendor, project, billing, shipping, and item details.

docs.title: Purchase Order Details
docs.description: The Purchase Order Details page allows you to view and manage a single purchase order (PO). Depending on your role and the PO status, you can perform actions such as editing, submitting, approving, rejecting, closing, or printing the PO.

docs.title: Purchase Orders
docs.description: A Purchase Order (PO) is a formal document issued by a buyer to a vendor or supplier, specifying the products or services they wish to purchase. It acts as a legal offer to buy and helps track orders from creation to delivery.

docs.title: Create Company

blogPosts.content:
We’re excited to announce an update to the **Purchase Order (PO) printing feature** in Spacelinx MES!

Previously, when printing a PO, you had to print **all columns** by default. Now, you have the **flexibility to choose exactly what information you want to include** in your printed documents.

### What’s new?

When you click **Print PO**, a new **Print Options dialog** will appear. Here’s what you can do:

- **Select which fields to include:** Part Number, HSN, Manufacturing Part Number, Tax Group, Tax Value, and Tax Amount.
- **Easier readability:** Only include the information you need, making your printed PO cleaner and more focused.
- **Quick and simple:** Just tick the checkboxes and click **Print** — no extra steps required.

### Why this is useful

- Print **custom POs** for different departments or purposes.
- Reduce paper usage by printing only relevant information.
- Make it easier for your team to review and approve POs.

### How to use it

1. Navigate to the **Purchase Orders** section.
2. Click **Print PO** on the PO you want to print.
3. Tick the checkboxes for the fields you want to include.
4. Click **Print**. That’s it — your customized PO will be ready to use.

We hope this update makes handling Purchase Orders even easier for your daily workflow!

Stay tuned for more user-friendly improvements in Spacelinx MES.

blogPosts.content:
SpaceLinx MES (Manufacturing Execution System) is an advanced digital platform designed to streamline aerospace and high-precision manufacturing workflows.  
It bridges the gap between planning and production, ensuring **real-time visibility**, **traceability**, and **process control** across your entire manufacturing lifecycle.

---

## 🚀 What is SpaceLinx MES?

SpaceLinx MES is part of the SpaceLinx Digital Suite — a modular, scalable ecosystem for manufacturing and engineering excellence.  
It integrates multiple domains such as **PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)**, **Procurement**, **Inventory**, and **Production** — enabling teams to operate in a unified environment.

---

## 🧠 Core Capabilities

- **PLM Integration:** Centralized product and parts data management with real-time BOM synchronization.
- **Production Control:** Plan, execute, and track manufacturing processes across multiple work centers.
- **Procurement Automation:** Streamlined purchase orders and supplier collaboration with complete traceability.
- **Inventory Management:** Live stock tracking with location-wise bin management and material movement history.
- **Analytics Dashboard:** KPIs and performance tracking with data-driven insights for operational improvement.

---

## 🧩 Why SpaceLinx?

- Tailored for **Aerospace**, **Defense**, and **Advanced Manufacturing** environments.
- Built with **modular microservices** for flexibility and scalability.
- Provides **real-time synchronization** between engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain systems.
- Powered by a modern stack — React, Node.js, and cloud-native architecture.

---

## 🔒 Digital Transformation Made Easy

SpaceLinx MES is not just a system — it’s a foundation for digital transformation.  
From digital work instructions to automated quality checks, it empowers organizations to achieve **paperless, connected, and efficient manufacturing**.

---

## 💡 What’s Next?

Stay tuned for upcoming posts where we’ll explore:

- **Module Deep Dives** (PLM, Procurement, Manufacturing)
- **Integration Workflows**
- **Deployment and Customization Tips**
- **Security and Role-Based Access**
- **Analytics & Visualization Features**

---

> ✨ _SpaceLinx MES — Building the future of intelligent manufacturing, one process at a time._
